pipeline.stage1Desc: Unicode NFC normalization, pydantic format validation, date parsing
pipeline.stage2Desc: 12-digit format & demo Luhn check digit against registry mock
pipeline.stage3Desc: Phonetic blocking, Jaro-Winkler, and Indic script transliteration matching
pipeline.stage4Desc: IsolationForest & robust z-score on age, CGPA, and sanctioned intake ratio
pipeline.stage5Desc: Weighted composite risk score and append-only SHA-256 hash chaining

audit.title: Immutable Cryptographic Audit Trail
audit.description: Every pipeline action is recorded in an append-only hash chain linking SHA-256 hashes of previous states.
